speaker: DX-4
text: Recommend investigation. Recommend snacks. Probably.

speaker: Sola
text: Ugh! ...Fine. Beginner's luck.

speaker: Dusty
text: Head east past the cactus gardens to the Sunset Tunnel. It runs clear under the sea to the Molten Frontier. Every Linker's road starts there.

speaker: Narrator
text: Your team is rested. The whole Molten Frontier is open to you now.

speaker: Narrator
text: Hank Briggs's Relay Tower is on Ferrox, through the Forge Gate. Forge Miner Dax guards the gate, and nobody gets past him without a battle.

speaker: Helix Grunt
text: Helix Directive! These spore pools are Helix property now. Scram!

speaker: Helix Grunt
text: The siphons! Dr. Moor's going to get every drop back...

speaker: Helix Grunt
text: You beat my partner? Then you'll have to beat me too. These tanks stay full!

speaker: Helix Grunt
text: Fine! Take your swamp back! I'm calling the shuttle.

speaker: Sola
text: There you are. I've been waiting by the Spore Pools all morning. Let's see if you've kept up!

speaker: Sola
text: ...Okay. You're getting good. Don't let it go to your head.

speaker: Pell
text: Helix Directive, Field Division! Step away from the docks, kid. This is official business.

speaker: Pell
text: Admin Vex is going to be so mad at me...

speaker: Helix Grunt
text: Admin Vex said to leave the children to Hexcoil. Gladly!

speaker: Helix Grunt
text: Hexcoil, no! Pull back, pull back!

speaker: Sola
text: One more battle before I go. For old times' sake.

speaker: Narrator
text: A Helix shuttle drops down beside the Deep Sea Ferry dock. Sola climbs aboard. "Don't follow me." The doors hiss shut.

speaker: Dr. Vashti
text: You made it to Neonis! Kit's up on the highest rooftop in the city, wiring an old broadcast dish into that pulse.

speaker: Dr. Vashti
text: If anyone can make that signal talk, it's Kit. Listen...

speaker: Narrator
text: Word comes from Glyphos: the old temple walls have started to glow. The Deep Sea Ferry sails there from the Long Dock.

speaker: Helix Guard
text: Intruder in the Forge! Nobody gets near the control room!

speaker: Helix Guard
text: Somebody... sound the alarm...

speaker: Grub
text: Psst. Admin Bronn runs Helix Station's engine bay. Get past him and you can reach the Observation Deck.

speaker: Admin Bronn
text: Thorne's lost his mind. That Rift will swallow us all. Beat me, and I'll open the way to the Observation Deck.

speaker: Admin Bronn
text: ...Go. The Observation Deck is that way. Stop him.

speaker: Narrator
text: A shimmering girl made of crystal light is waiting at the shrine, flickering at the edges like a candle.

speaker: Liss
text: I am Liss, a Ystran echo. What's left of one, anyway. Zib knows my voice.

speaker: Narrator
text: At the last wind shrine, Liss is waiting again, clearer than ever.

speaker: Mortimer Kade
text: Seven Shards, Linker. Come to my lab on Umbra before you win the eighth. There's something you need to see.

speaker: Narrator
text: Later that night, at the Harbor Tower, Captain Marsh slots the core back in. For a second, nothing.

speaker: Strand
text: The General's soldiers have the crater sealed tight. But nobody stops a Helix shuttle. Get in. I'll fly you past the cordon.

speaker: Narrator
text: With Novaryx's light ahead of you, the way down into the crater is open.

speaker: Teo
text: And Kael? Kael Thorne, holding the seal shut? We climbed down into that crater together, twenty years ago. Kael, Imogen, Orra and me.

speaker: Marisol Fenn
text: Welcome to the Crystal hall. Twenty years of champions have stood where you're standing. Shine for me!

speaker: Marisol Fenn
text: Brilliant. Truly brilliant.

speaker: Duke Harrow
text: Welcome to the Sonic hall, kid! Let's make some noise!

speaker: Duke Harrow
text: What a finale! Encore, encore!

speaker: General Ostrander
text: The Gravity hall. I held a crater for twenty years. Let's see if you can hold your ground.

speaker: General Ostrander
text: ...You held. Good.

speaker: Narrator
text: Glassy branches glitter under a huge red sun that is slowly going out.

speaker: Narrator
text: Dr. Moor's poison has your partner covered in spots and hanging still...

speaker: Narrator
text: Two Helix scouts in white coats are poking around the crane yard, scanning the scrap piles.

speaker: Helix Grunt
text: Readings say the Starfall signal runs right under this yard. Mark it for the Director.

speaker: Helix Grunt
text: Someone's coming! Fall back!

speaker: Narrator
text: The scouts slip away between the cranes.

speaker: Narrator
text: Thick Helix hoses snake out of the glowing spore pools into humming siphon tanks.

speaker: Narrator
text: Where the hoses drink, the pools have gone pale and still. The whole swamp smells like burnt sugar.

speaker: Helix Grunt
text: Keep those tanks filling! Admin's orders!

speaker: Narrator
text: A woman in a patched explorer's vest, a big question mark stitched on the back, is sketching the cave walls by lantern light.

speaker: Tamsin
text: Oh! A Linker. Name's Tamsin. Thirty years of exploring, and I still haven't found the place I'm looking for.

speaker: Tamsin
text: Here's the one thing thirty years taught me. A capture isn't taking. It's asking. Hold out your hand first.

speaker: Tamsin
text: You're headed for the crater, aren't you? I can see it on your face. Then I'll turn up when you need me.

speaker: Watchman
text: Ships only leave Dustmere with launch clearance from a Keeper. Win a Signal Shard and the sky is yours.

speaker: Hank Briggs
text: Come see what's in my hangar. Small and sleek, cream and gold, pink engines, bubble cockpit. That's your Nana Wren's old starship. I've kept it safe for her grandkid all these years. Launch clearance approved. Fly safe, Linker.

speaker: Narrator
text: Underneath sits a sleek little starship: cream and gold, pink engines, a bubble cockpit.

speaker: Narrator
text: By the time you and Sporix reach the bridge, the long first day is over and night has fallen. DX-4 is still beeping at the canyon.

speaker: Narrator
text: By the time you and Plazmo reach the bridge, the long first day is over and night has fallen. DX-4 is still beeping at the canyon.

speaker: Narrator
text: By the time you and Gloopa reach the bridge, the long first day is over and night has fallen. DX-4 is still beeping at the canyon.

speaker: Narrator
text: Something past the old stone bridge is sending a signal. You click on your flashlight and go, Sporix close behind.

speaker: Narrator
text: Something past the old stone bridge is sending a signal. You click on your flashlight and go, Plazmo close behind.

speaker: Narrator
text: Something past the old stone bridge is sending a signal. You click on your flashlight and go, Gloopa close behind.

speaker: Liss
text: Don't fight it. When the moment comes... listen.

speaker: Narrator
text: Dr. Vashti is waiting for you at her lab: the big dome with the telescope, across the plaza.

speaker: Narrator
text: DX-4, the old scout robot by the dome homes, is beeping like crazy at the canyon.

speaker: Narrator
text: Sola is waiting for you at the Trading Post, across the canyon bridge.

speaker: Narrator
text: Over Static's broadcast, every Keeper joins in: Hank, Dr. Moor, Captain Marsh, Static, Basalt, Ingrid, Echo and Iris, Kade.

speaker: Narrator
text: On every world, every Alienmon sings with them.

speaker: Narrator
text: Fungaroth blazes like a small star and pushes the Rift closed with light.

speaker: Narrator
text: Solarach blazes like a small star and pushes the Rift closed with light.

speaker: Narrator
text: Abyssor blazes like a small star and pushes the Rift closed with light.

speaker: Seedmother
text: Then my children will make Ystra green again, and the Warp Gate will carry them to their friends whenever they wish.

speaker: Seedmother
text: Then my children will stay with the friends who took them in, and the Warp Gate will bring them home to visit.

speaker: Seedmother
text: Both. Of course. Why should a home have only one door?

speaker: Mom
text: Good morning, sleepyhead! Dr. Vashti called. She's waiting for you at her observatory lab.

speaker: Mom
text: It's the big dome with the telescope, across the plaza. Go on, your partner is waiting!

speaker: Lab aide
text: Lab aide: Dr. Vashti has been waiting for you! She's by the pod table.

speaker: Kid
text: You're getting your first Alienmon today? Lucky! Dr. Vashti's lab is the dome with the telescope.

speaker: Tank tech
text: Tank tech: This hydro tank used to cool the whole station. Now it's full of water Alienmon!

speaker: Kit
text: My Gloopa sniffs out loose bolts. It's better at it than me!

speaker: Kit
text: My Abyssor can heal the blight, slowly, tree by tree. We'll stay and do this part.

speaker: Kit
text: My Sporix sniffs out loose bolts. It's better at it than me!

speaker: Kit
text: My Fungaroth can heal the blight, slowly, tree by tree. We'll stay and do this part.

speaker: Kit
text: My Plazmo sniffs out loose bolts. It's better at it than me!

speaker: Kit
text: My Solarach can heal the blight, slowly, tree by tree. We'll stay and do this part.

speaker: Narrator
text: One huge eye blinks at you, then at Sporix.

speaker: Narrator
text: One huge eye blinks at you, then at Gloopa.

speaker: Narrator
text: Under a ring of glowing mushrooms sits an old, cracked seedpod. Its beacon is still pinging.

speaker: Narrator
text: It's no cousin. The pod is empty, still calling for whoever hatched from it twenty years ago.

speaker: Narrator
text: Zib bumps the old pod gently and beeps a soft reply. Somewhere out there, its pod-mate is doing just fine.

speaker: Zib
text: ...Biiip.

speaker: Narrator
text: A golden sun over a green world. Tall figures raise their arms to it.

speaker: Narrator
text: The glyphs read: YSTRA. Home. The garden that sang.

speaker: Narrator
text: A vast tree-mother, roots wrapped around glowing seeds.

speaker: Narrator
text: The glyphs read: THE SEEDMOTHER. She gave her children wings of pod and light, and sent them far.

speaker: Narrator
text: A dark tide swallows the stars one by one. A pale world sits in its mouth.

speaker: Narrator
text: The glyphs read: THE DEVOURER. It does not hunger. It simply ends.

speaker: Narrator
text: Saga says nothing. The hooded figure only bows... and the battle begins.

speaker: Narrator
text: Saga's hood dips in one slow, deep bow.

speaker: Narrator
text: Strand's stolen shuttle skims low over the General's cordon.

speaker: Narrator
text: You pull the Helix Keycard from the main terminal. Out the window, the shuttle pad lights up.

speaker: Narrator
text: Saga bows to you once more. Zib's lights won't stop flashing.

speaker: Dusty
text: Haven't seen a Cactling bloom in years. They grow out in the Cactus Gardens. Catch one and show me?

speaker: DX-4
text: Bzzt. Three of my bolts rolled off toward the Trading Post. Retrieve them?

speaker: Narrator
text: The pink Alienmon puffs up its gills and glares at the wild Alienmon roaming the Trading Post. It wants you to chase them off.

speaker: Narrator
text: After your third win, the pink Alienmon happily hands you a Harmonic Pod it was guarding.

speaker: Dax
text: Beat all five trainers on the Frontier. Anyone you've already beaten counts. Do it and I'll make it worth your while.

speaker: Dax
text: All five! Here, a Singularity Pod. Don't waste it.

speaker: Grub
text: Heh, pleasure doing business. One Singularity Pod, as promised.

speaker: Kade
text: My old notes are scattered around this lab. They prove Thorne knew the Devourer was real.

speaker: Narrator
text: A soft voice rises from the crystal and joins you.

speaker: Narrator
text: The crystal hums with the echo's voice.

speaker: Scrapper
text: A Forgemaul's been hammering down by Coolant Pond at night. Nobody's caught one.

speaker: Junker Rizz
text: These cranes are full of free scrap. Finders keepers!

speaker: Junker Rizz
text: Fine, fine! I'll find another yard.

speaker: Junker Marta
text: Rizz lost? Then I'll jam the cranes myself!

speaker: Junker Marta
text: Ugh. Hank's got a bodyguard now.

speaker: Junker Bolt
text: I'm the boss of this crew. You won't beat me!

speaker: Junker Bolt
text: Okay, okay! We'll leave the cranes alone.

speaker: Dancer Vee
text: Round one! Keep up with the beat!

speaker: Dancer Vee
text: Wow, you've got rhythm!

speaker: Dancer Juno
text: Round two! Let's turn it up!

speaker: Dancer Juno
text: The crowd is cheering for YOU now!

speaker: Dancer Kix
text: Final round! This is my solo!

speaker: Dancer Kix
text: Encore! Encore!

speaker: Miner Brick
text: Down here, only the tough survive. Let's go!

speaker: Miner Brick
text: Tougher than you look.

speaker: Driller Ona
text: My drill's never lost a fight!

speaker: Driller Ona
text: Huh. My drill just lost a fight.

speaker: Carver Sol
text: Brick and Ona were warm-ups. I'm the real deal.

speaker: Carver Sol
text: Okay. You're the real deal.

speaker: Crew Chief Tova
text: You beat my whole crew? Then face the chief!

speaker: Crew Chief Tova
text: Ha! The deep crew salutes you.

speaker: Narrator
text: The little sporeling clings to you all the way home. The elder presses a pouch of Med Gels into your hands.

speaker: Narrator
text: You retune the antenna to the crater pulse.

speaker: Dr. Vashti
text: Triangulated. The pulse comes from inside the crater... and from somewhere far beyond it.

speaker: Narrator
text: The shuttle's cargo hold is burst wide open. Something inside is buzzing.

speaker: Narrator
text: You scoop up a stray Glitchbug!

speaker: Narrator
text: You take a rubbing of the carved stone.

speaker: Narrator
text: A stone guardian stirs and blocks the hall. Monolet!

speaker: Narrator
text: You turn the mirror. A beam of light jumps toward the great doors.

speaker: Researcher
text: You saved us both. Please, take these supplies.

speaker: Narrator
text: You open the cage. The Alienmon inside blinks at the light.

speaker: Narrator
text: A Nullbot powers up in front of the server. Intruder!

speaker: Narrator
text: You light the lantern. Warm light spills across the street.

speaker: Echo & Iris
text: We knew you'd do it. But it's still nice to watch.

speaker: Narrator
text: You turn the node until it clicks into line.

speaker: Marisol Fenn
text: I've been polishing my crystals since our last battle. Ready?

speaker: Marisol Fenn
text: Still the Prime Linker. Brilliant.

speaker: Duke Harrow
text: A rematch! Let the music swell!

speaker: Duke Harrow
text: Bravo. Bravo!

speaker: Narrator
text: Saga bows once. The rematch begins.

speaker: General Ostrander
text: Again, Linker. Show me you have not gone soft.

speaker: General Ostrander
text: Hmph. Not soft at all.

speaker: Dr. Vashti
text: Register 150 Alienmon in your Xenodex and I'll give you three of my rarest pods.

speaker: Dr. Vashti
text: One hundred and fifty kinds catalogued! You've earned these.

speaker: Liss
text: Meet them gently. Calm five of them, in battle or with your beam, and the forest will breathe a little easier.

speaker: Mina
text: You know what? He likes you. Walk out onto deep water and Splodge will come and carry you anywhere.

speaker: Narrator
text: In the cage beside it: a knitted blanket and a note, signed with just one letter. S.

speaker: Ystran echo
text: ...the mountain's heart remembers Ystra... go deeper...

speaker: Sporefolk elder
text: Our little one wandered into the mist. Follow the glowing mushrooms!

speaker: Ystran echo
text: ...the great doors sleep... guardians of stone keep the halls...

speaker: Ystran echo
text: ...gather our voices... so the Seedmother can hear...
